table.name: all_agencies
table.viewSql: SELECT prison.prison_id AS agency_id, prison.name, 'PRISON'::text AS legacy_type FROM prison UNION ALL SELECT court.court_id AS agency_id, court.name, 'COURT'::text AS legacy_type FROM court UNION ALL SELECT hospital.hospital_id AS agency_id, hospital.name, CASE WHEN hospital.high_security THEN 'SECURE_HOSPITAL'::text ELSE 'HOSPITAL'::text END AS legacy_type FROM hospital UNION ALL SELECT probation_office.probation_office_id AS agency_id, probation_office.name, 'PROBATION_OFFICE'::text AS legacy_type FROM probation_office UNION ALL SELECT police_custody_suite.police_custody_suite_id AS agency_id, police_custody_suite.name, 'POLICE_CUSTODY_SUITE'::text AS legacy_type FROM police_custody_suite UNION ALL SELECT approved_premises.approved_premises_id AS agency_id, approved_premises.name, 'APPROVED_PREMISES'::text AS legacy_type FROM approved_premises UNION ALL SELECT agency.agency_id, agency.name, agency.agency_type AS legacy_type FROM agency;
